# LNURL Documents

This directory contains LNURL specification documents in LUDS format.

Each LUD (Lightning URL Specification) defines a protocol layer
built on top of the Lightning Network.

## Specifications

- [LUD-0](0.md) — Base protocol
- [LUD-1](1.md) — LNURL-pay
- [LUD-2](2.md) — LNURL-auth
- [LUD-3](3.md) — LNURL-channel
- [LUD-4](4.md) — LNURL-withdraw
- [LUD-5](5.md) — LNURL-fast
